component.name: Hammer Store
component.summary: Browse and install packages with hammer

description.p: Hammer Store is the graphical frontend for the hammer atomic package manager on HackerOS. Browse thousands of Debian packages with a clean, modern GTK4/libadwaita interface designed for HackerOS.

ul.li: Browse featured, categorised, and installed packages
Full-text search with filters by category, status, and size
Package detail pages with description, screenshots, dependencies, changelog, and installed files
Atomic install and remove — every operation creates a new generation
One-click rollback to any previous generation
Live-patch support — no reboot required for eligible packages
Disk and package statistics dashboard
Source management — add, remove, and enable/disable repositories
Offline mode — shows cached data when network is unavailable
Keyboard shortcuts (Ctrl+F, Ctrl+R, Alt+←, Ctrl+1–7)
Package details with 4 tabs: Description, Dependencies, Changelog, Files
Async screenshot loading from AppStream metadata
Search filters: category, status (installed/available/updates), sort order
UpdatesView with per-package changelog in expandable rows
InstalledView with sort controls and category grouping
StatsView: disk usage by category, store cache size
SettingsView: persistent preferences (GLib.KeyFile), source management
Progress terminal with pkexec for privileged operations
OperationQueue to serialise concurrent install/remove
Keyboard shortcuts: Ctrl+F, Ctrl+R, Alt+←, Esc, Ctrl+1–7
Offline mode detection via GLib.NetworkMonitor
Hero banners on Discover page for top featured packages
PackageCard redesign: async icon loading, NEW badge, rating
AppStream XML metadata integration (icons, screenshots, descriptions)

description.p: History view, undo support, and size information on package cards.
Category browsing, update notifications, and dark mode toggle.
